title: Deterministic agent capability discovery and preflight

rules.catalog: Catalog acceptance validates a declared adapter/profile only; it is not provider support.
rules.setup: Setup acceptance validates bounded configuration and credential-reference readiness; values never enter the record.
rules.eligibility: Eligible means an offline attempt is structurally permitted. It does not mean the adapter ran or the provider is live.
rules.unknown: Unknown is used for incomplete or unverifiable observations; it cannot be promoted to eligible or successful.
rules.execution: Adapter execution is always not_performed in this offline contract.
rules.live: Live provider support is always unverified in this offline contract.

limitations: The model checks supplied declarations and synthetic observations only.
It does not inspect a catalog, inject credentials, run an adapter or benchmark, contact a host or provider, or establish live support.
An eligible result is offline planning evidence, not execution, provider success, or benchmark measurement.
